usedFor: Kickbox checks if email addresses are deliverable, with “Verify Email Address” for one and “Verify Batch Emails” for many.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Verify Email Address” in Kickbox
bestTemplate.why: An incoming message can give an address to check, and the action says if it is deliverable.

watchOut: Any email you send after a check still waits in Needs you for your approval.
